test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a bowed instrument that Pundit Ram Narayan, an Indian musician popularised and made him known internationally?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarangi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pundit Ram Narayan**

 
 
• **​**He is a Hindustani classical musician who plays the **bowed instrument, the sarangi.**
 
• He is credited with popularizing the sarangi as a solo classical instrument.
 
• He was born in 1927 in Amber village in **Rajasthan.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Guitar** is a musical instrument usually consisting of six strings.

 
 
• The guitar originally evolved from the instrumental** sitar.**
 
• **Baiju Dharmajan** is famous for playing the Guitar.
 
 
 
• **Veena** is an Indian string instrument that has been named after Saraswati, the Hindu goddess.
 
 
• **Asad Ali Khan** was an Indian musician who played the plucked string instrument **Rudra veena.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sarod** is the most ancient musical instrument.

 
 
• **Ustad Ali Akbar Khan and Brij Narayan** are some of the notable exponents of Sarod.
 
 
 
• **Tabla** is one of the most popular musical instruments in India. It consists of a pair of drums.
 
 
• **Zakir Hussain **is a famous** Indian tabla player.**
 
 
 
• **Sitar** is also a popular musical instrument that has a long neck.
 
 
• **Ustad Imrat Khan and Pandit Ravishankar **are famous **Sitar players.**
 
 
 
• **Hari Prasad Chaurasia **is famous for playing the **flute.**
 
• **Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma** is a renowned **santoor player.**
